g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Synthetic NIST FIPS 197 AES-256 Key-Recovery & Hash-Preimage (aes256-key-recovery)
Clean-room Boyar–Peralta S-box (32 AND / 81 XOR-XNOR) · Factored GF(2⁸) MixColumns · 10 calibrated instances (8 SAT / 2 UNSAT), R ∈ {1, 2, 3, 4, 14}
NIST FIPS 197 AES-256 SPN Round r ∈ {1..R} & 256-Bit KeyExpansion
AES-256 KeyExpansion (Nₖ = 8 words = 256 bits → 4(R+1) words, up to 60 words / 52 S-boxes at R = 14)
Davies–Meyer AES-256 Hash-Preimage Equivalence & Dual-Plaintext Miter
H = AES-256(K, P) ⊕ P ⟺ AES-256(K, P) = C where C = H ⊕ P (bit-identical circuit)
For k = 256 (aes256_r14_k256_dual_sat), two blocks share KeyExpansion: AES-256(K, P₁)=C₁ ∧ AES-256(K, P₂)=C₂ (unique 256-bit key).
Graduated 10-Instance Difficulty Ladder: Reduced-Round Propagation → Full Diffusion → Full 14-Round AES-256
10 instances (8 SAT / 2 UNSAT) · 2,192–69,908 vars · 7,488–276,176 CNF clauses · 173,288 native XORs · XCNF / CNF / AIG / ANF · MIT License
